data.name: Climb Waterslide and Slide
data.description:
Welcome to the  Climb waterslide and slide🌊 

WORLD 6 IS HERE

Your friends will earn money when you are offline
Weekly updates!

Climbing famous landmarks around the world
Climbing the world's tallest waterslide
Experience the thrilling water slides
Collect coins along the way
```🔒 Unlock new rafts and equipment```
🐾 Obtain the rarest pet!  
🎁 Join our group to receive exclusive rewards 🎁

Code: CCU MONEY
